verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents a real REST API covering syncs, models, sources, and destinations (hightouch-docs-13, hightouch-probe-rt-1) and a separate MCP server that lets an AI assistant build audiences, journeys, syncs, and creatives in natural language (hightouch-docs-10/11/12, hightouch-probe-4). However, core UI-only features like audience/journey building are explicitly described as done in a 'no-code UI' (hightouch-docs-1/24/35), and the plain REST API guide never lists audience or journey endpoints, only syncs/models/sources/destinations — so parity between UI and raw API is not fully documented; the MCP path partially closes this gap but is a distinct conversational layer, not the generic API. Missing for 10: explicit REST API endpoints for audience/journey creation, and confirmation that MCP/API actions cover 100% of UI capabilities (e.g., Ad Studio, AI Decisioning) rather than a subset.
